description: This PHP file contains a test class 'CandidateInterviewSchedulingAPITest' which extends 'EndpointIntegrationTestCase'. It tests the 'CandidateInterviewSchedulingAPI' class related to candidate interview scheduling functionality within a recruitment module of an HRM system. The test class includes setup routines and multiple test methods for CRUD operations, although some methods are expected to throw 'NotImplementedException'. The test methods perform fixture setup, mock service registration, and API endpoint validation.
